purpose: Counterfactual check of the Magnicon XXF-1 10 kHz output filter order under the same relaxed thermal-backbone profile. Compare c2=0 first-order versus documented second-order Bessel responses with a shared cutoff profiled only over the manual's 10 kHz +/-2.5% tolerance.

magnicon_filter.manual_statement: Connector-box anti-alias filters are second-order Bessel, cutoff 10 kHz +/-2.5%.
magnicon_filter.semantics: Order 1 is deliberately counterfactual. It tests whether one excess modeled pole could account for the zero-like residual; it is not an alternative hardware claim.

guardrail: The XXF-1 manual explicitly documents a second-order Bessel 10 kHz +/-2.5% output filter. The first-order branch is a diagnostic counterfactual only. A better first-order fit would indicate that the measured chain attenuates roughly one pole less than the present model over the fitted band; it would not establish that the connector-box hardware is actually first order.
